Summaries.eng: Bang! One day, the Universe exploded! The explosion produced a number of light crystals which scattered in the Earth and became energy coins. Some energy life entities also came to the Earth and existed as mini cars to chase light crystals. Once those mini cars grasped light crystals, they would return to their original forms. A group of evil attempted to plot against the Earth with the super power of light crystals. To protect the Earth, the righteous kids Hawley, Kinson and Yolan help the mini cars of the justice side to collect energy coins. Armed with Eagle Car and Dragon Car, the two brothers are ready to fight against the Commander-K leaded evil force. The war is on…

Aliases: Ji Jia Shou Shen: Baolie Feiche
Jī Jiǎ Shòu Shén Zhī Bào Liè Fēi Chē

Summaries.eng: The stealthy Sparkbug infiltrates the headquarters of a wealthy and well armed CEO.
NiteBite and NightWeaver battle over an Animatter supply at a roadside fueling station.
MonkeyWrench gives SpikeStrip and CrocShock a lesson in music appreciation.
Delanore sees an opportunity for a big score at an underground Screecher pit fighting event.
Hangtime is on the run from NightWeaver but his Animatter supply is running low.
T-Wrekker has to call on an old underworld friend when he finds himself in a deep hole.
Delanore challenges Napoleon to a Beetle Ball competition.
NightWeaver's easy animatter score is interupted by the meddlesome NiteBite.
Three kids share tall tales of the legendary Gate Creeper.
V-Bone and T-Wrekker race through the alleys of Pen City for a prize Animatter puck.
RevaDactyl teaches a young Talon X recruit a tough lesson.
Buffalo Jaxxon gives Bivouac his father's Screecher, Knight Vision and teaches what it means to Screech.
The Fly CEO hires the mysterious Gatecreeper to deal with Sparkbug.
When Ringo heckles Skane Silvershade's performance Hangtime tries to teach him a lesson. T-Wrekker and Hangtime showdown.
Al Bah Bah infiltrates the compound of the wealthy sultan in search of a stash of Animatter.

Titles.eng: A Cat of a Different Stripe

Summaries.eng: V-Bone challenges Rattlecat in hopes of proving herself worthy of joining the notorious All Claw United.
The Fly CEO makes another attempt to thwart Sparkbug by enlisting Stingshift to take him out.
Stormhorn intervenes when Racertooth tries to get away from a heist at the Sultan's camp. A nailbiting chase ensues.
When Mammoth breaks down in the he's pounced on by Spikestrip and Crocshock but they might not be the only ones lurking in the creepy swamp.
Takka Tuk has second thoughts about helping a stranded Raccoon on a swampside road.

A big explosion occurred in the distant galaxy. Countless powerful cosmic energy rushed towards the earth and turned into article chips scattered in the gale city. The mechanical warriors in the universe also came to the earth in order to obtain these chips. They stayed in mini cars and formed partners with humans to start a battle around the chips. The two brothers Fei Lun and Qing Feng, who dreamed of becoming explosive speed racers, took advantage of the summer vacation to come to Gale City, where they met the explosive speed storm Falcon.

Fei Lun couldn't agree with his younger brother Qing Feng's rough fighting style. After they walked out of the arena, a mysterious exploding speeder suddenly appeared and snatched Fei Lun and Qing Feng's heraldic chips. The two brothers separated due to a dispute. Qingfeng ran out and met Feilong, a wandering speedster who snatched their chips. After forming a partnership, he and Fei Lun started a competition. During the competition, Fei Lun made Qingfeng understand his weaknesses.

Qingfeng, who got the explosive speed car, met Anya when he was teasing Kai who had laughed at them. Anya, who admired Kai Sa, and Qingfeng quarreled. The three Explosive Speedsters sensed the existence of the Awakening Chip at the same time. In order to improve their strength, they went to find the Awakening Chip that would allow the Explosive Speedster to use its special moves. However, what was waiting for them was Kai Sa's men Kuang Hu and Chizhu. During the battle, the Storm Falcon's Awakening Chip appeared.

Fei Lun got the awakening chip, which aroused Anya's jealousy. Even though she knew that the awakening chip of Storm Falcon was useless, she still planned to snatch it. After trying many tricks, Anya still failed. Kuang Hu and Chi Zhu, who were observing from the side, appeared. Under their instigation, Anya set a trap for the two brothers Fei Lun and Qing Feng. The two brothers who fell into the trap had to fight Kuang Hu and Chi Zhu. Can they defeat the enemy?

Qingfeng's food disappeared one after another, and a Explosion Speed ​​Racer named Renault found them. Renault's Explosion Speed ​​​​Armored Armor ran away from home, and the disappearance of Qingfeng's food was caused by the greedy Explosive Speed ​​​​Armor. Fei Lun and Qing Feng decided to help Renault retrieve the thunder-blasting steel armor. They tracked into the terrifying botanical garden. What kind of dangers will they encounter in the botanical garden?

Kuang Hu and Chi Zhu's mission this time was to report the whereabouts of Fei Lun and others to Kaisa, but Fei Lun and others had already gone out to look for the thunder armor. Renault finally found the Thunder Armor, but the Thunder Armor actually lost his memory and couldn't remember anything. So Renault and his team took the Thunder Armor to a familiar place, hoping that the Thunder Armor could regain its memory as soon as possible.

During the day, Renault and Thunder Steel Armor competed with Qingfeng in mechas. It was difficult to decide the winner, but a beautiful girl with a mysterious origin disrupted the situation. At night, Renault and Thunder Armor were resting in a forest, but they encountered a mysterious opponent in the dark. They were defeated without seeing the opponent clearly.

Kaisa asked Kuang Hu and Chi Zhu to snatch the awakening chip from Fei Lun. Qingfeng has been lackluster since losing to Kaisa. Ma He encouraged them and promised to take Feilun and the others for special training. When Fei Lun and others were conducting special training, Kuang Hu and Chi Zhu appeared, and Fei Lun and Qing Feng worked together to defeat them.

Long Dou is Kuang Hu's apprentice. He wants to avenge his master and compete with Fei Lun and others. Long Dou sent out the Vajra Ape, Fei Lun sent out the Storm Falcon, and Qingfeng sent out the Exploding Whirling Dragon. However, as soon as the Exploding Whirling Dragon appeared, it was knocked away by the Vajra Ape. However, the Vajra Ape fell in love with Chizhu during the game. In the end, the Vajra Ape was defeated by the Storm Falcon, ending the game.

Their mother hired a teacher from the tutoring center to supervise Fei Lun and Qing Feng in their studies, but the teacher's nonsensical teaching methods made them dizzy. Qing Feng, who had not completed his homework and wanted to skip class, angered Mr. Bang. Teacher Bang ordered him to have a fun competition with Renault, who also did not complete his homework. The loser would be sent home and would never be able to participate in the explosion competition again. In the end, Qingfeng lost, but the teacher lost his memory due to an accident, so Qingfeng escaped and was able to continue to stay in Gale City.

Fei Lun supervised Qingfeng's summer homework, but Qingfeng's heart was focused on steel armor training. Before the end of the summer camp every year, the challenge competition held in the aerial arena will begin tomorrow. This news makes the players participating in the summer camp excited. However, only players with awakening chips are eligible to participate in the competition. Renault actually also got the awakening chip of the Thunder Armor. Before they want to participate in the Contest, they must also participate in the Challenge Tournament. In the end, Feilun, Qingfeng, and Renault were all selected.

Fei Lun and Qing Feng accidentally encountered the Jedi Lion and the Sky Boom Dragon who had escaped from the doctor, but the two sides had conflicts. During the dispute, the Jedi Lions accidentally severely injured the Storm Falcon and the Explosive Wyvern. Fei Lun and Qing Feng had no time to repair, so they had no choice but to compete. During the battle, the Vajra Ape and the Jungle Lurker pressed forward step by step, making it difficult for the Storm Falcons to withstand them. Just when Fei Lun and Qing Feng were about to lose, the Jedi Lion and the Sky Boom Dragon arrived in time. With their help, Fei Lun and Qing Feng finally saved the day and won.

In order to deal with the next opponent, Fei Lun and Qing Feng urgently need the awakening chips of the Jedi Lion and the Sky Boom Dragon, but the chips are in the hands of Dr. Aozi. Dr. Aozi proposed that they exchange the Storm Falcon and the Explosive Wyvern for the Awakening Chip, but was rejected. At this time, the Storm Falcon disappeared, and Feilun was looking for it anxiously, but found that it had gone to Zeta. Zeta told Feilun the past of the struggle between light and darkness, and helped them get the awakening chip. In the end, the Jedi Lion and the Sky Boom Dragon used their special moves in the game and defeated their opponents in one fell swoop.

In order to witness Wu Ze's victory, his parents came to Gale City. For this reason, Wu Ze was very nervous. He found Fei Lun, hoping to fight again to express himself. In order to prevent Wu Ze from being taken home by his parents to undergo hellish training, Fei Lun and the Jedi Lion reluctantly agreed to compete. During the battle, Wu Ze remembered the hard training in the past and the days of working together with the jungle lurkers. He finally broke out and defeated Fei Lun with his extraordinary performance, winning the approval of his parents.

The awakening chip of the Thunder Armor was taken away, and the person who took it away was Fei Lun Qingfeng's opponent in the next game - the Niyu Nizhen brothers. The two also threatened that as long as Fei Lun and the others won, they would return the awakening chip to Renault. On the day of the competition, Qingfeng was unable to fight because of a stomachache. Feilun was one against two and could barely hold on. At the critical moment, Renault came to help and restored Qingfeng to normal. The Explosive Whirling Dragon joined the battle and worked in harmony with the Jedi Lion, gradually gaining an advantage. Seeing that the game was about to end, the Kenni brothers took out the secondary heraldic chip and used the power of the chip to turn defeat into victory.

The Jedi Lion was upset about losing the game, so he decided to leave Fei Lun and Qing Feng with the Sky Boom Dragon to find a new partner. On the way, they met Mad Tiger Chizhu. Mad Tiger Chizhu tried to recruit them but was rejected, so he became angry and attacked. After learning about this, Fei Lun Qingfeng rushed to the rescue, but the Jedi Lion did not appreciate their kindness. In order to prove their strength, Feilun Qingfeng accepted the challenge of Mad Tiger Chizhu. In the end, their performance impressed the Jedi Lion and the conflict was resolved.

Blast Dragon got separated from Blade Dragon, their coordination failing completely. Blade Dragon had Blast Dragon blast open an exit, only to get trapped by debris itself. At the critical moment, Blast Dragon received help, transformed, and escaped. But in the ensuing battle, it was nearly injured.

Feilen and Qingfeng unexpectedly encountered the Escaped Lion and Thunderbolt Dragon, who had fled from the Doctor. The two sides clashed. In the altercation, the Escaped Lion and its allies accidentally inflicted severe damage on Storm Falcon and Blast Dragon. With no time for repairs, Feilen and Qingfeng had to compete with their damaged machines. During the battle, the Dark Gorilla and Jungle Stalker relentlessly pressed their advantage, overwhelming them.

Just as Feilen and Qingfeng seemed destined for defeat, the Ultimate Lion and Thunder Dragon arrived in the nick of time. With their help, disaster was narrowly averted and victory secured.

Fei Lun, Qing Feng and Renault took advantage of the break to play around in the aerial arena. Qing Feng, who was too excited, wandered around and was separated from Fei Lun and Renault in the blink of an eye. Qingfeng, who was alone, came to a strange second-hand store, but was deceived by the owner and signed an unequal treaty. Qingfeng was about to attack, but Wu Ze, the store owner's bodyguard, suddenly appeared and challenged Qingfeng. The two started an unruly fierce battle, and Qingfeng finally won, and the shop owner was caught by Fei Lun and Renault who had just arrived.

Storm Falcon and Explosive Wyvern are suddenly unable to explode into shape. At a loss, Fei Lun and Qing Feng decided to accept their partners' advice and give them shock therapy. Storm Falcon and the others pretended to cooperate with the treatment, but accidentally fell into the hands of Ao Zi's gang. During the escape process, they accidentally entangled Dr. Aozi's device on their bodies, causing a big explosion. Fei Lun and Qing Feng were in danger during the explosion. In order to save their partners, the Storm Falcon and the Explosive Whirling Dragon finally unleashed their potential and exploded and transformed again.

In order to obtain the precious heraldic chip, King Kong and the others boarded a spaceship and flew to space. Unexpectedly, an accident happened on the way. In the end, they escaped successfully and returned to Earth.

The mysterious pink nurse suddenly joins the challenge and becomes Fei Lun's next opponent. She also recruited members from all over to form a huge pink army, and even Qing Feng joined them. During the game, Feilun fell behind due to a conflict between the Storm Falcon and the Jedi Lion. Fortunately, at the last moment, Fei Lun's words moved the Storm Falcon and the Jedi Lion. With their cooperation, Fei Lun finally turned defeat into victory. At this time, everyone who joined the Pink Corps also lost their way and quit, making the Pink Nurse very angry.

Feilun and Longdou battled on Sword Mountain. With Blast Computer's approval, Anya and Kaisa joined, making it a team match. Outmatched, Feilun threw the Awakening Chip to aid the Lion of the Wilderness, but Kaisa knocked it away. Qingfeng then gave him the Thunder Dragon's chip, enabling the Lion to unleash its ultimate attack and win.

Later, Feilen and Qingfeng encountered the Escaped Lion and Thunderbolt Dragon, who had fled the Doctor. A clash erupted, and the pair accidentally severely damaged Storm Falcon and Blast Dragon. With no time for repairs, they fought on but were overwhelmed by Dark Gorilla and Jungle Stalker.

Just as defeat seemed certain, the Ultimate Lion and Thunder Dragon arrived, helping them narrowly avert disaster and secure victory.

Wuze was stunned by a strange fish while fishing, and suddenly had superpowers when he woke up. Using this power, Wuze won successive challenges and became a popular superstar. The friends were worried about Wu Ze's abnormality, but Wu Ze didn't take it seriously. On the eve of a competition, Wuze suddenly fell down with a fever, and the space around him also changed. Just when everything fell into chaos, Wu Ze suddenly woke up. It turned out that everything that happened before was just a dream, and Wu Ze was still the Wu Ze who behaved weirdly and was not popular.

A series of strange things happened in the aerial arena, and the host Burst speculated that this might be the work of aliens. Qingfeng and others visited the aerial arena at night and actually discovered aliens. The alien said that he came to Earth because he liked explosive speeding, so Qingfeng and the others happily practiced explosive speeding with the aliens, and soon became friends. Just when everyone was about to say goodbye to the aliens, Qingfeng unexpectedly discovered that the aliens were actually the hosts posing as Burst.

Maher is about to fight against Zeta, presenting a unique exhibition match to the audience. For this reason, Ma He specially invited Feilun and Qingfeng to be his special training opponents. During the special training, Mah told them about his past and dreams, as well as his determination to defeat Zeta and win first place. On the day of the game, Mach and Zeta started a series of fierce battles, but finally lost. However, this wonderful game inspired Feilun and Qingfeng, and they decided to continue working hard and become A-level players as soon as possible.

The finals of the challenge competition are about to begin. Only new players who pass the challenge competition and are promoted to B-level players can participate in the Explosion Crystal Points Competition. Everyone was eager to try, but Renault, who was at the bottom, was very frustrated. The dejected Renault wandered around and met the Emerald Stone Dragon, a wandering speedster. Seeing a glimmer of hope, Renault asked the Emerald Stone Dragon to become his partner. On the other hand, Feilun Qingfeng fell into Kaisa's trap during the game and was in danger. At this time, Renault arrived with the Emerald Stone Dragon, rescued them, and won the final championship in one fell swoop, and finally successfully advanced with everyone.

Feilun, Qingfeng, and Leino went to an amusement park to relax but found no rides. They ran into Anya, Wuze, the Ni brothers, and the Mad Tiger crew, all searching for a magical place that grants wishes. They raced for exclusive access, and Anya won. But the location only had a spring that could recharge Blast Racer's energy—not grant human wishes.

Later, Feilen and Qingfeng encountered the Escaped Lion and Thunderbolt Dragon, who had fled the Doctor. A clash erupted, and the pair accidentally severely damaged Storm Falcon and Blast Dragon. With no time for repairs, they fought on but were overwhelmed by Dark Gorilla and Jungle Stalker.

Just as defeat seemed certain, the Ultimate Lion and Thunder Dragon arrived, helping them narrowly avert disaster and secure victory.

The Explosion Crystal Points Competition officially begins, with Qing Feng facing off against the mysterious player Bai Jing in the first match. During the competition, Bai Jing's Demonic Thunder Mingyu showed amazing strength, while Qingfeng's Sky-shattering Explosive Dragon was not far behind. In the end, the two sides with the same score decided to use their special moves to fight for the last chip. Unexpectedly, Yao Lei Mingyu's special move was so powerful that it not only overwhelmed the shock wave of the sky-shattering dragon, but also destroyed the venue's facilities, causing the game to be suspended. In the end, the game ended in a tie, and Qingfeng luckily escaped the fate of failure.

Zeta discovered that the exploding computer was affected by darkness and began to produce black chips, reminding everyone to be careful. Thunder Armor ran away from home because of Renault's preference for Jade Stone Dragon. He accidentally came into contact with Dr. Aozi's equipment and split into many clones. Renault fought against Qingfeng and accidentally used a black chip, causing the Emerald Stone Dragon to lose control. At the critical moment, the Thunder Armor and the clones appeared and temporarily stopped the Emerald Stone Dragon. Finally, with Zeta's help, the Emerald Stone Dragon returned to normal.

In the next match, Fei Lun Obsidian played against Mach Pink Nurse. In order to gather information, Dr. Aozi ordered Obsidian to make friends with Fei Lun. However, Obsidian's weird behavior made Fei Lun laugh and cry. On the other hand, Maher's younger siblings came to Gale City and were warmly received by the pink nurse. The game started, with both sides going back and forth. At this time, Maher's younger brother and sister accidentally fell off the stage, and the Jedi Lions rescued them in time. Everyone temporarily suspended the game for this reason. At this time, Obsidian attacked Mach regardless of morality. Although he won the game in the end, he attracted Fei Lun's blame.

Dr. Aozi created an opportunity for Fei Lun Qingfeng to go to the ski resort so that Obsidian White Crystal could continue to approach them. In the ski resort, Obsidian was forgiven by Fei Lun, and in order to teach Bai Jing what happiness was, Qingfeng took him to have fun together and made a lot of jokes. At this time, the host of Burst announced today's battle arrangement, with Qingfeng Baijing combination versus Niyu Obsidian combination. In the end, Ni Zhen replaced Ni Yu, who had a stomachache, and the two sides had a fierce battle on the snow. In the end, Qingfeng Baijing cooperated properly and won, and the two became friends.

Renault defeated Kai Sa but gained more notoriety for oversleeping and missing a race. Frustrated, Kai Sa faced Fei Lun in competition. They battled fiercely, with the Hyper Sonic War Bat gaining the upper hand. Just as Kai Sa seemed poised to win, the Warbat faltered at the last moment, handing victory to Fei Lun. Unable to accept defeat, Kai Sa nearly broke down, unaware Dr. Aozi had orchestrated the outcome.

Later, Feilun and Qingfeng encountered the Jedi Lion and Thunder Dragon, who had escaped the doctor. Tensions flared, and in the clash, the pair accidentally severely damaged Storm Falcon and Explosive Dragon. With no time for repairs, they competed injured but were overwhelmed by Dark Gorilla and Jungle Stalker.

Just as defeat seemed certain, the Ultimate Lion and Thunder Dragon arrived, helping them narrowly avert disaster and secure victory.

The shocked Kaisa was walking on the street and accidentally met the pink nurse. Pink Nurse wanted to cheer Kaisa up, but her method was unbearable and forced Kaisa to hide around. The kind-hearted Fei Lun took Kaisa in, and the two watched Qingfeng's game in the room. Through the communication with Fei Lun, Kaisa gradually remembered the original intention of participating in the competition and began to reflect on what she had been doing. But Dr. Aozi laughed at him and summoned the Dark Explosion Speeder to control him with the power of darkness.

The mysterious explosion speedster broke into the competition site and caused damage, causing the competition to be suspended. On the other hand, Fei Lun Qingfeng encountered the scarred Supersonic Battle Bat. The Supersonic Battle Bat told them that the mysterious speedster in the ring who injured him was also Kaisa's new partner - the Soul-Eating Battle Tiger. It turns out that Kaisa has been controlled by darkness and her temperament has changed drastically. Kaisa found Feilun Qingfeng and told them about the past struggle between darkness and light, and threatened to overthrow the light. In the points match, Kaisa faced off against Fei Lun again. He commanded the Soul-Eating War Tiger to fight and brutally defeated Fei Lun and the Jedi Lion.

The annual general election for the popularity of explosive players has begun. Not only can the champion compete with Zeta, but his score will be 10 times higher than usual. Everyone was in high spirits and tried their best to canvass votes, but in the end the votes were almost the same. At Ma He's suggestion, everyone decided to show their strength to the audience through a battle and continue to canvass votes. After a fierce battle, Qingfeng won and the number of votes rose to first place. At this time, a child who had been helped by Fei Lun cast a key vote, which ultimately made Fei Lun and Qing Feng tie for first place, becoming the most popular kings together.

Fei Lun and Qing Feng won the title of Popularity King and were able to compete with Zeta. However, in the competition, facing the astonishing Steel Claw Bear and Zeta, Fei Lun flinched. This angered Zeta and caused a dispute between Qingfeng and Feilun. With Obsidian's help, Fei Lun remembered his past agreement with Qing Feng, regained his courage, and challenged Zeta again. Qingfeng felt Fei Lun's determination and came to fight alongside him. During the battle, the two unleashed their incredible potential, tied with Zeta, and finally gained Zeta's approval.

Feilun and Qingfeng prepared to face Mach Kaisa, determined to rescue him from darkness. Mid-match, Kaisa suddenly attacked his teammate Mach. The corrupted Blast Computer malfunctioned, endorsing Kaisa's actions. Chaos erupted as Kaisa commanded the Soul-Devouring War Tiger to unleash a black energy sphere, aiming to corrupt the brothers. Mach stepped forward, absorbing the dark energy for them. Zeta appeared and rescued Feilun and Qingfeng.

Later, they encountered the Jedi Lion and Thunder Dragon, who had escaped the Doctor. Tensions flared, and in the clash, the pair accidentally severely damaged Storm Falcon and Explosive Dragon. With no time for repairs, they competed injured but were overwhelmed by Dark Gorilla and Jungle Stalker.

Just as defeat seemed certain, the Ultimate Lion and Thunder Dragon arrived, helping them narrowly avert disaster and secure victory.

The aerial arena fell into chaos, and the Explosion Crystal Points Competition was suspended. Many Explosion players, including Mach, were also controlled by darkness and became Kaisa's subordinates. Kaisa even used the power of the exploding computer to summon the ultimate weapon of darkness, the Magical God of Destruction, preparing to use it to destroy light and let darkness envelope the entire universe. At this time, Zeta told Fei Lun Qingfeng that they were the messengers chosen by the light, and then used all his power to send them to a different space to find the last hope of the light.

Feilun Qingfeng and their Explosion Speeder came to another universe, where they met another Zeta and Storm Falcon, and learned from Zeta that the last hope of light, the Explosion Mobile King, was sealed here, but to unlock the seal, the Explosion Computer that had fallen dormant in this universe must first be awakened. In the end, Fei Lun Qingfeng relied on the light power in his body to awaken the Explosion Computer and revive the Explosion Mobile King.

Fei Lun and Qing Feng returned to their own world with the Explosive Mobile King, and had a final battle with Kaisa driving the Magical God of Destruction. With firm will and belief, the two gradually gained the upper hand. At this time, Aozi revealed his true colors. He abandoned Kaisa, assimilated himself with the magical God of Destruction, and launched all the dark power to attack the light. In order to defeat the darkness, Zeta also sacrificed himself and assimilated with the Explosive Mobile King. At this time, Feilun Qingfeng's light power finally fully awakened. They tried their best to launch the final blow, defeated the magical God of Destruction, and saved the future of the universe.

Titles.eng: The Adventure Of Red Horn Star
the fire of war has reignited

Summaries.eng: After the cosmic duel of Tian Yuan, the dying Luo Sha was saved in the nick of time by the ancient super-civilization era bursting emperor - Hunting Heavenly Spirit - and came to Earth.
The Institute possesses a lot of information gathered back with the mystery of the ancient bursting speeder.

The mysterious Explosive Speeder Endless Fire appeared in front of Prime, and just at this time, an energy reaction actually appeared at the bottom of the sea, and unknown monsters attacked the crowd in the Deep Sea Ruins.

The Endless Fire actually came from the ruins, and just when everyone was wondering, the eccentric old grandpa appeared, and the self-proclaimed administrator tried to make things difficult for everyone.
The destination this time is the Deep Pupil Desert, and in order to enter it, the group must find the help of a young girl named Yelan, but to their surprise Yelan actually sees everyone as enemies.
He Kui is asked to find the remaining 4 burst chips and forbidden to meet Ye Lan, but Ye Lan doesn't remember the two brothers at all due to amnesia.
Roxas tells He Kui to behave himself or suffer the consequences.
Ding He was imprisoned inside a relic with heavy machinery, and this was an extremely scary guy!
Roxas asks Dinghe to find the bursting chip, he senses a new energy reaction. So, Dinghe sets off.

Titles.eng: It's all because of the meat loaf.

Summaries.eng: Fresh meat buns are coming out of the oven, and the little man is hawking them at the top of his lungs.
The Doctor has gone to a research conference, when a new relic with energy reactions appears, and Feilun, Prime, and Yelan are paired up for an adventurous journey that is full of surprises.

The super genius Zhang Zhao, whom even Luo Sha is also afraid of, suddenly launches an operation, and he, who has been secretly investigating, takes control of the entire institute's system, and even challenges the Bakufu Brothers.
New relics have appeared again, Feilun they set off in high spirits, but unexpectedly, they stepped into a trap carefully laid by the enemy, Feilun they have to face the oncoming enemy.

This time the ruins turned out to be an oversized underground forest with long-extinct dinosaurs, and just as everyone was getting excited, something horrible happened, and a never-before-seen powerful enemy woke up from his slumber and came to the crowd with a terrifying explosive speeder.

Panza's power is far above the crowd, Feilun and the others can't fight against it at all, and as the underground world starts to collapse, the crowd starts a big battle to escape in a race against time.
The Sentinel God sealed Panza 200 million years ago, and to Panza, everyone is his prey.
The Goshinjin was awakened, and it was the strongest burst speeder that sealed the Hunt for the Sky Spirit.

The Doctor tells everyone not to be too pessimistic, they have the help of the Sentinel God in addition to the Burst icon. The new relics have reappeared, and Fei Lun and the others set off in high spirits, but unexpectedly, they step into a trap carefully laid out by the enemy, and Fei Lun and the others have to face the oncoming enemy.
Endless Fire they are all gone for some reason and the little ones are anxious.

The Sentinel God had always fought alone, it didn't get along with everyone. Panza's power was far above the crowd, Feilun and the others were unable to fight against it, and as they watched the underground world begin to collapse, the crowd launched a great battle for time to escape.

In order to find the final bursting chip as soon as possible, the group not only investigated the relics they had been to before, but also launched a cyber search, mysterious relics, horror relics, maze relics, they have to find clues to the bursting chip from all these strange and weird information.
Zhang Zhao suddenly disappeared, and even Luo Zha could not find his whereabouts, just then, a mysterious spiral tower appeared in the desert, so the people rushed to the spiral tower to investigate.

The always maverick Panza actually chose to help Roxas. Around the final bursting wafer, Panza and Feilun had a heated exchange. The new relics have appeared again, Feilun and the others set off in high spirits. Unexpectedly, they stepped into the traps carefully laid by the enemies, and Feilun and the others have to face the raging enemies.
In order to protect the bursting chip, Feilun and the others had a real-fake chip battle, first simulating an energy reaction to attract the enemy's attention, and then secretly hiding the real chip.

The fully awakened Hunter of the Sky Spirit showed amazing power, huge thunderstorms, multiple split giant rock, energy doubled the enemy step by step, the countdown to destruction has finally begun. Pansa's power is far superior to the crowd, Feilun and the others are unable to fight against it, and as the underground world begins to collapse, the crowd starts a race against time to escape.
The Royal Star God was suddenly nowhere to be seen, and it turned out that the move to eliminate the Sky Hunter's Prana required the consumption of the Royal Star God's life.

With the sacrifice of the Star God, the Rupture Brothers, Fei Lun, Prime, and a group of friends, finally defeated the ancient Rupture Buggy, the Sky Hunter, which had been resurrected by the hand of Roshi. They thought that peace would visit this world from now on, but a mysterious crustal shift suddenly appeared. Along with the tremor, unknown relics appeared in front of everyone. In order to investigate the truth, Feilun and the others traveled there in a hurry and were accidentally involved in the battle. In the chaos, they all work together to drive away Tiger Lin, who tries to destroy the relics, and learn from the two brothers, Gan Ning and Zuo Rong, who have been fighting side by side, the secret that the super ancient civilization has been hiding all along.

Gan Ning and Zuo Rong, who were descendants of the Guardians, officially joined the team. After the discussion, the group decided to search the relics again to see if there were any burst wafers present inside. On the other hand, Luo Sha and the mysterious Shangguan Hei began to cooperate. It turns out that in the previous duel, Shangguan Hei saved Luo Sha and attempted to use his power to synthesize the explosive chips into the king's staff that controls the most powerful explosive speeder, the Emperor Meteor. In response, Shangguan Hei sends Tiger Lin to reconvene He Kui and Ding He to investigate the ruins. The two sides met and the battle was imminent. Just then, Gan Ning and Zuo Rong showed their strength as guardians and repelled the enemy in one fell swoop. The new relics appeared again, Fei Lun they set off in high spirits, but unexpectedly, they stepped into the trap carefully laid by the enemy, Fei Lun they have to face the raging enemy.

Zhang Zhao lost his hand and was captured, and was forced to start parsing the data of the Ultra Ancient Civilization for Shangguan Hei. Meanwhile, Feilun and his party also found a new explosive relic through the clues of the explosive iconography. The people immediately went there, but the heavy organs of the relics caused all sorts of big trouble for the people. Feilun and his group, who managed to enter with great difficulty, ignored Tiger Lin and the others who followed them. Inside the relics, the two sides fight fiercely over the explosive chip, but the chip ends up in the hands of He Kui by accident. Feilun and the others are trying to get it back, but at that moment, the Ruins suddenly collapsed and the mysterious Spiral Tower appeared.

The Spiral Tower was releasing an energy that could not be resolved. With no choice but to take the chip back to the Institute first, Feilun had no choice but to do so. Just then, the Star God appeared! It turns out that it was the Spiral Tower's energy that awakened the Star God. Although they were full of questions and confusion, everyone was very happy about the return of the Star God. On the other hand, Zhang Zhao, who had secretly stolen important information, took the opportunity to escape from the relic battleship, and the angry Shangguan Hei immediately chased after him. The terrifying power of the Shura Underworld Emperor completely suppressed the Reaper, and seeing that Zhang Zhao was about to be defeated, Feilun and Ye Lan, who had discovered the anomaly, arrived in time. With the power of the Royal Star God, the crowd repelled Shangguan Hei with great difficulty. Panza's power is far above the crowd, Feilun and the others can't fight against it at all. Seeing that the un...

Deeply touched by the cartoon, Optimus ignored Feilun, who tried to persuade him, and insisted on finding a formidable enemy of his own. However, by mistake, he failed to find his rival, but he found a treasure map with the location of the Blaster Chip on it. Overjoyed, Keng Feng immediately went to investigate. On the other hand, in order to prove his ability to his master, Shangguan Hei, Tiger Lin chose to act alone. It so happened that he also found an identical treasure map. Tiger Lin and Optimus Prime met each other on a narrow path and inexplicably formed a friendship in the midst of competition. In the end, Keng Fung failed to find the chip, but found his arch-enemy as expected.

During the search for the relics, Feilun and his party are on guard, except for Dr. Zhou Hao, who remains unorthodox. Unable to tolerate it, Frozen Snow and Crackeritis run away from home, only to be mistaken by another Guardian descendant, Hu Shuo, for his partner, Feilun. Hu Shuo is quite excited and takes them to deal with the intruding He Kui and the others without listening to the explanation, leaving Ice Seal Snow and the others, who are unable to utilize their full strength, in a bitter battle. Fortunately, Feilun and his party arrive in time to defuse the crisis. The Doctor also realizes his mistake and sincerely apologizes to his flying cars. In order to find his partner, Hu Shuo joins Fei Lun and his group and leads them to the location of the relics.

In the ruins, Hu Shuo, desperate to find his partner's flying car, goes off on his own against everyone's advice. Worried about him, Prime chased after him, and the two came to the depths of the ruins. On the other hand, He Kui and Ding He also sneaked into the ruins, and also arriving at the same time was Tiger Lin, who they had shaken off earlier. Several groups of people arrived at the bursting wafer's storage point by mistake. Tiger Lin and his trio attacked, intending to kill Hu Shuo and seize the chip. As Prime fights to stop them, Hu Shuo accidentally awakens his real partner, Wild Skin, and drives the enemies away in one fell swoop. However, the explosive chip is still taken by the enemy. The new relics appeared again, Fei Lun and his team set off in high spirits, but unexpectedly, they stepped into the traps carefully laid by the enemies, and Fei Lun and his team had to face the raging enemies.

Nopi and Hushuo bring new energy to the Guardians' team. The enthusiastic Noppi organizes workouts for the group, and Hushuo actively tries to fit in, even cooking up some of his famous meat buns. For the sake of the delicious meat buns, Prime takes good care of Hu Shuo. However, his favoritism caused Gan Ning and Zuo Rong to complain. In the process of investigating the underwater ruins, Gan Ning, Zuo Rong and Ye Lan separated from the crowd and accidentally discovered Zhang Zhao who was investigating the ruins. The three of them follow Zhang Zhao and accidentally fall into the ambush of the enemy. At the critical moment, Zhang Zhao came to their aid and finally got them out of danger.

The hiding Shangguan Hei suddenly appeared and attacked, capturing Feilun and the others in one breath. The people were trapped by the Shura Underworld Emperor's sure kill and were unable to break free. It turned out that Shangguan Hei had already discovered the bursting chip here, and the reason why he hadn't left yet was to wait for Feilun and the others to throw themselves into the net and defeat them completely. Gan Ning rushes to help, but is still no match for the Shura Underworld Emperor. In a moment of crisis, Zhang Zhao came up with the idea of Burst Merge, using the special power of the Twin Flywheel to multiply the energy of the four Gan Ning's Burst Flywheel. All of them worked together and finally defeated the Shura Underworld Emperor. However the bursting chip was still snatched by Shangguan Hei. Panza's power was far above the crowd, Feilun and the others were unable to fight against it. Seeing that the underground world began to collapse, the crowd started a big batt...

Yu Xiang has a tooth decay from gluttony! In order to help it, Hu Lin follows the advice of He Kui and Ding He and goes to the Great Snow Mountain to look for replacement saber-toothed tiger teeth. On the other hand, Hu Shuo, who is looking for a place for special training, also arrives at the Great Snow Mountain. When they meet, Hu Shuo is touched by Tiger Lin's concern for his flying partner and offers to help and cures Yu's toothache. In order to repay Hu Shuo, Tiger Lin and the others also taught him various techniques of explosive strikes. There is a moment of peace between the two sides who were originally hostile.

Titles.eng: turn defeat into victory (idiom); to turn the tide

Summaries.eng: Three burst chips have already fallen into the hands of the enemy, and in order to cope with the worsening situation, the crowd started a special training program. Fei Lun is the most serious among them, even ignoring everyone to practice. Noticing that his brother is not in the right state, Optimus Prime is very worried, and just then, a new explosive relic appears. Faced with a tornado in his path, Feilun takes a risky step. At this point, Optimus reprimanded his brother loudly, making Feilun realize that he had to trust his partners and couldn't take it all on alone. In the end, everyone worked together to enter the relics and successfully stopped the Shura Undertaker to get the Burst Chip.

Titles.eng: lit. brothers who sing in unison

Summaries.eng: The four spiral towers that appeared earlier began to resonate, causing the weather around the world to become abnormal. The crowd was alarmed, and just then, Zhang Zhao suddenly appeared and told them the truth about the spiral towers. In order to stop the anomaly, Feilun put the bursting chip back into the relics, while Gan Ning and Zuo Rong volunteered to take up the task of guarding the chip. Sensing this, Shangguan Hei immediately dispatched He Kui to the relics to snatch the chip. In the end, with excellent tacit understanding, Gan Ning and Zuo Rong repelled the enemy and successfully guarded the explosive chip. A new relic appeared again, Fei Lun and his men set off in high spirits, but unexpectedly, they stepped into a trap carefully laid by the enemy, and Fei Lun and his men had to face the raging enemies.

Titles.eng: return in a swirl of dust

Summaries.eng: The defeated He Kui and Ding He did not leave, but instead camped on the spot, secretly spying on Gan Ning and Zuo Rong, in order to find an opportunity to snatch the burst wafers. During the process, He Kui and Ding He realized that Gan Ning and the others were actually studying. He Kui and Ding He are perplexed by such an inopportune move, but Gan Ning is unperturbed and instead tells them that this battle doesn't mean everything, and that they need to plan for the future. He Kui and Ding He are impressed by Gan Ning's words and plan for their future as well. Just then, Panza, who had long disappeared, suddenly appeared. Purgatory launches an onslaught, defeating Gan Ning Zuo Rong and stealing their explosive chips.

The resonance of the Spiral Tower reappears. In order to solve this big trouble, Fei Lun and his group decided to sneak into the Spiral Tower that first appeared to find a way to stop the resonance. Led by Zhang Zhao, the group broke through the organ barrier and successfully arrived inside the Spiral Tower to investigate. On the other hand, Panza launched a strong attack on the Relic Battleship, and Shangguan Hei engaged it. In the end, Purgatory was knocked to the ground, and Shangguan Hei got the explosive chip as expected. However, the defeated Purgatory actually got up again and started to absorb the energy from the Spiral Tower. As the Spiral Tower malfunctioned, Fei Lun and his team had no choice but to retreat temporarily. Pansa's power is far superior to that of the others, and Feilun and his group are unable to fight against it. As the underground world begins to collapse, the group begins a race against time to escape.

In order to unlock the secrets of the Spiral Tower, Zhang Zhao proposed a whimsical way to utilize the harvesting as well as the energy flowing out of the Spiral Tower to travel through time and space in one breath and go back to the past era. Although the crowd was incredulous, they agreed to Zhang Zhao's method after considering it. At the same time, the three of them, He Kui, who had sensed the movements of the Guardians, immediately launched a pursuit. In front of the energy convergence point, a fierce clash erupted between the two sides. In the end, Zhang Zhao seized the opportunity to open the passage through time and space and brought everyone to the past era. However, unexpectedly, this was not the Emperor's Meteor era that they were scheduled to travel to, but the era that Ye Lan had lived in.

The people decided to split up and investigate. Ye Lan returned to the place where she once lived and met her parents. Ye Lan was about to recognize them but was stopped by Zhang Zhao who followed her, Zhang Zhao said that it would disturb time and space and told her not to do so. The two continue their surveillance and surprisingly discover a shocking secret, it turns out that Zhang Zhao is also a person from ancient times and he is related to the clan that made the Spiral Tower. Time is limited and the group has to return to modern times in a hurry. However, Ye Lan could not let go of his parents and wanted to take them with him, but in the end it did not work out and Ye Lan could only bid farewell to his parents with tears in his eyes.

After returning from the past era, the crowd learned of Zhang Zhao's true identity. On the other hand, Zhang Zhao also gained a lot of intelligence in the past. In order to analyze the information, Zhang Zhao took the initiative to invite Hu Shuo to investigate with him, to the surprise of everyone. It turned out that Zhang Zhao was planning to use Hu Shuo's ability to communicate with animals to find the relics in the forest. At this time, the three of them, Hu Lin, also arrived, and even Pan Sa appeared. At the critical moment, Zuo Rong and Qing Feng arrived in time to stop the enemies, buying time for Zhang Zhao and Hu Shuo to obtain the hidden information. The new relics appeared again, Fei Lun and the others set off in high spirits, but unexpectedly, they stepped into the traps carefully laid by the enemies, and Fei Lun and the others had to face the raging enemies.

Luo Fury's power was finally fully restored! In order to complete the plan, Luo Fury launched an operation and attacked Zhang Zhao's secret base and took him captive. On the other hand, in order to unlock the secret of the Twin Speeder, Ye Lan, Gan Ning and Zuo Rong go to the Spiral Tower to investigate. At this time, He Kui and Ding He appeared and told Ye Lan that Zhang Zhao was captured by Luo Shi and asked her to go alone to rescue him. Ye Lan has no choice but to agree. Sensing that things were not going well, the Gan Ning brothers immediately returned to the institute to inform Fei Lun and the others. When everyone finally arrived, Luo Fury had already opened the sealed Exploding Ruins with the help of the two ancients.

In order to seize the bursting chip, Luo Sha held Ye Lan and Zhang Zhao hostage as he headed towards the depths of the sealed relics. In order to stop him, Feilun and his party sped up and chased after him. However, the organs in the relics ignored Luo Shi and instead attacked the people who were the guardians. It turned out that the organs would attack everyone except the Super Ancients. With no choice but to destroy the mechanism, Feilun and the others had to move forward, however, Shangguan Hei blocked the way of the crowd again. After fighting, Feilun and the others finally broke through the blockade and rushed over to rescue Ye Lan Zhang Zhao, but the explosive chip was still taken away by Luo Sha. Pansa's power is far above the crowd, Feilun and the others can't fight against it at all. Seeing that the underground world is starting to collapse, the crowd starts a big battle to escape in a race against time.

In order to be in the best condition for the final battle, Fei Lun and his party started their special training. On the other hand, Shangguan Hei actually tricked Hu Lin into performing a dangerous enhanced transformation on Yu Xiang in order to achieve victory. Just then, the reaction of the bursting relic appeared. In order to fight for the final chip, the two sides erupted into conflict on the relic island. In order to buy time for his partner, Prime chose to stop Tiger Lin alone. In the midst of the fierce battle, Ashes suddenly lost control, and even Tiger Lin's instructions were no longer obeyed. In order to save Ashes, Dynaflex stepped forward. In the end, his action infects Tiger Lin and the two of them work together to bring Ashes back to normal.

Just as Feilun and his party were heading towards the final bursting wafer, Shangguan Hei led the Cultivating Underworld Emperor and suddenly appeared to stop them. At the same time, Luo Sha also launched an operation. In order to prevent the wafers from being taken away, Zuo Rong and Gan Ning took the initiative to take on the task of breaking the back so that the crowd could continue to advance. Shock and Roar fought hard against the Shura Emperor, but the gap between the two sides was too great, and the battle was lopsided. In the face of despair, Gan Ning and Zuo Rong did not give up, they remembered their grandfather's teachings, and finally exploded their potential to turn the tide of the battle and completely defeat the Shura Emperor.

Feilun and his group arrived at the center of the relics, but they couldn't find a way to make the burst wafers appear. With no choice but to split up and investigate. On the other hand, Ding He and He Kui secretly set up traps with the intention of obstructing the pace of the crowd, but they were ignored by Fei Lun. The furious Ding He launched a surprise attack, and the crowd fought back. Taking this opportunity, Zhang Zhao and Ye Lan continue their investigation and successfully find the chip. However, Luo Sha suddenly appeared and took away the chip. They immediately attacked to get back the chip. During the fierce battle, Panza appeared again, making the situation even more complicated. At that moment, the sky and the earth changed, and the emperor woke up! A new relic has appeared, and Fei Lun and the others set off in high spirits. Unexpectedly, they stepped into a trap carefully laid by the enemy, and Fei Lun has to face the fierce enemy.

The Emperor's Meteor attacked everything on the ground indiscriminately, and its amazing destructive power made Feilun and his party's eyes widen. Seizing the opportunity, Roxas gathered the energy from the bursting chips into one and summoned the King's Staff. With the power of the King's Staff, Luo Sha began to command the Emperor's Meteor to attack Fei Lun and the others. The crowd counterattacked, but it had no effect at all. Just then, Panza attacked and actually destroyed Emperor Meteor's tentacles. But what people didn't expect was that Emperor Meteor actually possessed amazing regenerative abilities. In the light of the Emperor Meteor's counterattack, Panza disappeared in front of the crowd.

In front of the powerful Emperor Meteor, Feilun and the others' attacks seemed useless. Just then, Purgatory, which was left behind by Panza, appeared and offered to cooperate with Feilun. In order to defeat Emperor Meteor, Feilun decisively agreed. Purgatory and the Royal Star God fought side by side, using all their strength to engage Emperor Meteor. However, even though Purgatory sacrificed itself to launch the attack, it failed to do any real damage to Emperor Meteor. In this moment of despair, unexpected reinforcements appeared, and the Sky Hunter Spirit actually descended from the sky. In order to prove its power, the Sky Hunter Prana launched an attack on Emperor Meteor! Pansa's power was far above the crowd, Feilun and the others were unable to fight against it, and as the underground world began to collapse, the crowd started a big battle to escape in a race against time.

In order to prove that he was the strongest, Sky Hunter Prancer pressed forward and tangled with Emperor Meteor. Feilun's group realized that it was difficult for their previous attacks to cause damage to Emperor Meteor, and that the addition of the Heaven Hunting Prana might be their only chance to defeat Emperor Meteor. So they immediately joined the fight, wanting to use the power of the Sky Hunting Spirit to destroy Emperor Meteor. Both sides fought fiercely, and it was hard to tell the winner from the loser. Just then, Shangguan Hei suddenly snatched the King's Staff. It turned out that this was all Shangguan Hei's plan, all along he had been cooperating with Luo Shi, just wanting to use Luo Shi to replenish the energy for the King's Staff, and then seize the King's Staff to control Emperor Meteor.

Shangguan Hei's plot officially surfaced, and Luo Sha was furious, using his last strength to destroy the King's Staff before disappearing. At this point, no one could manipulate the Emperor's Meteor anymore, but it continued to wreak havoc. In order to protect the world, the people began the final battle. During the battle, Feilun and his group unlocked the secret of the Gemini, and utilized the power of the Gemini to defeat Emperor Meteor. In the end, all of them worked together and defeated Emperor Meteor. Because of this battle, Skyhunter changed his original intention of destroying the world and decided to give humanity another chance to prove itself.

The two brothers Fei Lun and Qing Feng encountered a subsidence crisis in the commercial street. Qing Feng was in trouble trying to save the girl Xiao Hua. Just when Fei Lun was extremely anxious, a mysterious man who called himself Zhan Sen appeared with two exploding speed cars. He handed a beast god chip to Fei Lun. Fei Lun used the chip to help the speed car break through the sky and transform into a long eagle, and rescued his younger brother and little girl. But at this time, the villain Hei Fu arrived and claimed to take away the explosive speeder, and the two sides immediately started a fierce fight. With the witty cooperation of the two brothers, they repelled the black ambush and learned from Zhan Sen that the earth's energy was in danger. The two brothers resolutely joined Zhan Sen's team of guardians to find twelve explosive speedsters to protect the earth. Before that, they must continue to practice their flying skills to improve their strength.

Feilun and Qingfeng arrived in Xuyang City and met Yaxi while searching for the arena. During a match, an unexpected power outage occurred. Through Yaxi and the director, they learned of the city's energy crisis.

While investigating, they discovered Dr. Zhuang stealing energy. Qingyang Lu appeared with Pukong Changying and Lieyu Yantiger, driving Dr. Zhuang away.

Back at the arena, Heifu, disguised as the fake director, stole Feilun Qingfeng's chip. They fled and learned from the Xuyang Heart that the real director had been kidnapped.

While rescuing the director, Heifu seized their flying vehicle. During the confrontation, Yaxi discovered the Sunlight Deer's chip sealed in her necklace. After helping it transform, the Sunlight Deer reclaimed the Exploding Flyer and drove Heifu away.

Titles.eng: The Wrath Of The Red Demon The Boy Who Was Deceived

Summaries.eng: After Fei Lun Qingfeng and Yaxi bid farewell to the gym owner and left Rising Sun City, in order to tell Hei Fu that only ruthless means can achieve success, the Red Demon destroyed the arena and killed the gym director to intimidate Hei Fu. Later, the Red Devil discovered that Yallo, who happened to be returning home, had the laser-blasting Thunder Rhino that he needed in his hand, so he used a false image to blame everything about the arena and the curator on Fei Lun Qingfeng, and took the opportunity to trick Yallo and the Thunder Rhino into absorbing his dark energy. When Aki returned to the base, she found that the communicator given to her by her father could not contact the arena, and she was worried.

Everyone found that Aki and Qingyang Lu had rushed back to the arena, and the arena on the map had lost energy activity, so they rushed to the arena out of worry. Axi rushed home and found that the arena was destroyed. He sadly fought Heifu but lost. Feilun and Qingfeng arrived in time to defeat Heifu, while Heifu quietly slipped away with Yaluo. Zhan Sen, who was out investigating the energy company, learned about the situation and returned to the base to treat Aki and Qingyang Lu. After that, Zhan Sen told everyone about the Red Demon and the Earth Temple. Only then did everyone truly realize the crisis they were facing and began training to improve their strength. On the other side, Yaluo and Thunderous Rhinoceros completely absorbed the dark energy and were determined to take revenge on Fei Lun Qingfeng.

The Eye of Arcana detected that a large number of animals were sick in the forest outside the battle city. The guardians rushed to the forest. By examining the animals' bodies, they found that the animals contained a large amount of heavy metals. After detection, everyone discovered that it was a leak in the iron ore area that caused river water pollution. Fei Lun and the other three encountered Dr. Zhuang in the iron ore factory who was being chased by Manyi, a subordinate of the Red Demon. Everyone was trapped in the illusion of Manyi's skills. In order to gain everyone's trust, the doctor and the Magnetic Orangutan used their magnetic powers to break through the illusion and rescued everyone at the critical moment. The doctor used the special skills of the magnetic orangutan to absorb heavy metals from the water source, and led Fei Lun and the other three to rebury the chaotic iron ore.

Magna helped Fei Lun and others purify the polluted river, and Dr. Zhuang proposed to join Fei Lun and others' team. Fei Lun and others were undecided, so they took Dr. Zhuang back to the base and planned to ask Zhan Sen for his opinion. After returning to the base, Dr. Zhuang told everyone that he chose to join a well-financed energy company because of insufficient research funds. However, after successfully inventing the Powerful Crystal Core, he discovered that the Red Devil had been using the energy company and himself to destroy the earth, so he decided to betray the Red Devil and stole the Powerful Crystal Core back overnight. And combined a Dark Engineer with the Powerful Crystal Core to create the Powerful Chariot. Later, the doctor and Zhan Sen guided a group of speeders to train and integrate with the Power Chariot, and gave the Power Chariot to Fei Lun and others.

Qing Feng and Hell Yanhu accidentally entered the doctor's workshop while playing a mecha game and reminded the doctor to turn off electrical equipment at night. Everyone got news about the Demonic Dark Army and the energy speed car from the abandoned power plant. Zhan Sen, Fei Lun and others went in two groups to deal with it. When Fei Lun and the others were investigating in a deserted power plant, the Power Chariot disappeared while tracking the mysterious speed car. Everyone split up to search for it. Both Yaxi and Fei Lun fell into the trap of the mysterious speed car. Qing Feng, who had found nothing, was also attacked by Yaluo after returning. Fortunately, Fei Lun finally met and reconciled with the mysterious speeding lightning eagle. The two formed a partnership and defeated Yaluo. However, the power plant they were in was about to explode, and the way out was blocked. Finally, the doctor came to rescue Fei Lun and the others.

While training in the wilderness, Feilun and his companions stumbled upon a cement factory discharging pollutants. As they attempted to investigate, they encountered Hei Fu, Man Yi, and Yalo stealing energy resources. Battle erupted instantly. Qingfeng commanded the V-Battle Tank to merge with the Lightning Eagle. Upon detection, Yalo directed the Thunder Rhino to attack the V-Battle Tank, inducing fear within it. Seeing Feilun's team struggling, the V-Battle Tank overcame its fear and merged with the Sunlight Deer to unleash its ultimate attack. The wounds of the Feilun team slowly healed under the radiance of the Sunny Deer's ultimate attack, while a portion of the dark power within Yalo was also dispelled. Just as Yalo, having regained some memories, was about to reunite with Yaxi, Man Yi forcibly dragged him away. The Crimson Demon continued to deceive Yalo, claiming that Yaxi was being controlled by Feilun and Qingfeng.

Titles.eng: The Powerful Awakening Of The Desert Fire Lion

Summaries.eng: Fei Lun and others detected energy fluctuations in Stone City through the Eye of Arcana. After everyone rushed to Stone City, they found that there were countless energy fluctuations scattered in Stone City. Fei Lun and others decided to work separately to investigate the energy fluctuations one by one. While everyone was investigating energy fluctuations, Manyi and others were stealing natural gas energy in Stone City. Fei Lun and others followed the energy fluctuations to the Fire Lion Palace, but only saw the wild fire lion turned into a stone statue. Just as Fei Lun and others were looking for the Wild Fire Lion, Yaluo and others attacked. Yaluo kept attacking Fei Lun and others. At the critical moment, the Wild Fire Lion broke through the stone statue, helped everyone turn defeat into victory, and became Qing Feng's partner.

The Eye of Arcana detected energy fluctuations that exploded in the Biya Forest, and everyone immediately set off to go there. Everyone discovered that desertification had occurred on the edge of the forest due to excessive logging. While searching for the speeding car, the Lightning Eagle and Fei Lun had a disagreement, causing everyone to be ambushed by the menacing Qingya and other primitive people. At the same time, the Red Demon has sent Manyi Heifu and Yaluo to the Bia Forest to cut down trees and steal resources. Fei Lun and others helped Qingya repel the Demonic Dark Army who was cutting down trees, and also ran into the water-powered speeder Lingbo Bear. In the end, everyone gained Qingya's trust, and learned from him the rumors about the "evil bear" in the forest, Lingbo Bear, who only heard his voice but not his person. Qingya offered to take everyone to find Limbo Bear.

Titles.eng: Revealing The Truth, The Showdown Between Brother And Sister

Summaries.eng: Fei Lun and others found the Limbo Bear trapped in a trap in the forest. Qingya rescued the Limbo Bear and led Fei Lun and others to find the chip. Unexpectedly, Manyi and his group appeared at this time, forcing Fei Lun and others to hand over all the explosive speeders. Fortunately, Lingbo Bear completed his transformation and turned the tide of the battle to save everyone. The Lightning Condor supports Qingyang Deer in the battle against Thunder Rhinoceros. Qingyang Deer releases its special move and Yaluo's mask is shattered. The two brother and sister Yaluo finally recognized each other, and from this, Yaluo learned the truth about the destruction of the arena. In the end, Yaluo and Qingya agreed to join Feilun's team.

Everyone had breakfast happily, and the doctor introduced the dangers of disposable tableware to everyone. From the Eye of Arcana, news came that a speeding car had appeared in the collapsed nuclear mine, and everyone rushed there. But on the way, they discovered that the energy fluctuations of the target speedster Lotus Heart Parrot appeared and disappeared, and they couldn't help but feel anxious. At the nuclear mine base, everyone rescued Lingdang, the partner of Lotus Heart Parrot. It turned out that Lotus Heart Parrot had been taken away by Heifu Manyi. Everyone successfully reunited with the escaped Lotus Heart Parrot at the top of the mine, but was besieged by Hei Fu, Manyi and the iron barrel formation of the shadow giants. At the critical juncture, the Lotus Heart Parrot launched a special attack to resolve the situation. Afterwards, everyone rescued the miners from the collapsing mine, and Lianxin Parrot and Lingdang joined the protagonist team.

In the morning, the doctor claimed that there were new results in the research on the powerful tank, but the powerful tank did not dare to cooperate because of fear. The Eye of Arcana reported news of an energy speed car in the garbage dump outside Baez City. When everyone went to search the garbage dump, they learned that there were traces of the Dark Army in the forest. Zhan Sen and Earthquake Mammoth left the team to investigate and discovered a scene that shocked him. Others who were searching the garbage dump were attacked by a new enemy, Qian Tao. Qian Tao's flying car destroyed the mad armor and defeated everyone. His dinosaur tank Shura also destroyed the powerful tank. Fei Lun was defeated for the first time, and his self-confidence was severely frustrated. After Zhan Sen rescued everyone, the doctor told everyone the origin of the dinosaur chariot.

Ever since Fei Lun was defeated, they were worried that Qian Tao's powerful strength and the help of Dinosaur Chariot Shura would hinder their plan to find the flying chariot and open the temple. The Wagoner's injuries during the battle also made matters worse. But what is surprising is that the doctor integrated dinosaur fossils into the Power Chariot and made it into four dinosaur chariots, Chihuo, Xiaofei, Taotao and Yaya. After everyone got to know each other, they couldn't wait to start training. The dinosaur power of the Dino Chariot surprised everyone. With Qingfeng's efforts, Fei Lun gradually regained his confidence. At this moment, Zhan Sen suddenly fell ill and fainted to the ground. Everyone was panicked, but Yaluo felt a familiar aura from Zhan Sen. However, based on his trust in Zhan Sen, Yaluo only thought it was his illusion.

The Eye of Arcane Energy pinpointed the temple's location within an ancient forest, but needed final data from the Explosive Flyer to fully unlock it. Feilun resolved to take the initiative, retrieving three Blast Riders—including the Raven Eater—to locate the temple.

Using the Eye, they found the Raven Eater. Heifu and his allies ambushed them. During battle, the final Blast Rider, the Netherstorm Dragon King, appeared, aiding Heifu's forces. Scanning it with the Eye fully unlocked the Earth Temple's coordinates.

Zhansen proposed luring Heifu's group to the temple entrance to seize their flying machines and open the gates. Unexpectedly, the Crimson Mage arrived. He unleashed the Netherstorm Dragon King's power, snatched all the flying machines, and activated the temple himself.

The Red Demon forcibly used twelve flying cars to enter and open the temple. Fei Lun and the others also followed closely into the temple. After arriving at the temple, they were separated and divided into two groups. When Fei Lun's group went forward to break through the level, they met Xiangsheng Qilin, the guardian of the temple. After clearing up the misunderstanding, Qilin led Fei Lun's group through the level, unlocked the secret of the circular room, and obtained a mysterious chip. On the other side, Qingfeng's team also successfully cracked the mirror mechanism and obtained another mysterious chip. Fei Lun and Qing Feng finally reunited, but they met Qilin's brother Yu Rui Pixiu who had just been injured by the Red Demon. Yu Rui Pixiu led everyone to chase the Red Demon. When they passed the last level, everyone rescued the three Heifu people who had been abandoned by the Red Demon, and then entered the light gate leading to the arcane chip.

When Fei Lun and others stopped the Red Demon, Manyi, Qian Tao, and Heifu rushed over to help them fight against the Underworld Dragon King. Xiangsheng Qilin and Yurui Pixiu released their combined skills to control the Red Devil and the Underworld Dragon King. Manyi, Qian Tao, and Heifu took the opportunity to give the final blow, driving the Red Devil and the Underworld Dragon King into the abyss. Fei Lun and others decided to move forward to seal the arcane core. Manyi, Qian Tao, and Heifu decided to join Fei Lun's team after learning the purpose of Fei Lun and others. Through the murals, everyone learned about the war a hundred years ago and the most important partner of the energy speeders, the "Proud Dragon". Fei Lun Qingfeng awakened the sleeping Aotian Shenlong and informed the other party that everyone came here to seal the arcane core. However, Aotian Shenlong said that only by defeating him can he see the arcane core, and the speeders had no choice but to fight him.

It turns out that Aotian Shenlong just made a joke with everyone to test the strength of the speeders. He used his own light power to purify the dark power of the Black-eating Leopard, Poisonous Lizard and Destruction Crazy Armor. Zhan Sen told Aotian Shenlong that the arcane chip must be sealed to ensure that it does not fall into the hands of people like the Red Demon. Under Zhan Sen's words, Aotian Shenlong agreed to everyone's request and opened the Arcane Temple where the Arcana chips were sealed for everyone. Zhan Sen brought the arcana chip to the cliff to seal it, but his true identity was revealed and he handed the arcana chip to the Red Demon. The Red Devil told everyone how Zhan Sen was implanted with dark power, and locked everyone in an energy shield, and began to summon the source of evil and darkness for arcane fusion. Although the Sky-Breaking Eagle broke through the encirclement and released a killing blow to stop it, it failed.

The Crimson Demon inserted the final arcane core into the Dark Heart, then merged it with his chest, fusing with both the Dark Source and the Dark Heart. Though his protective barrier vanished during the process, the surge of energy proved unstoppable. His fusion succeeded—yet he discovered Earth's Arcane Core energy remained incomplete, and the world hadn't been destroyed.

Those sheltered in the mural gallery sensed this change. Spurred by renewed resolve, they bravely confronted the Crimson Demon. But the fused demon was overwhelmingly powerful. No coordinated attacks could scratch him. The Dinosaur Chariot exhausted its energy mid-battle.

Finally, the Crimson Demon's assault caused the temple to collapse. To help everyone escape, Lotus Heart Parrot coordinated with Yaya, who mustered her last strength to unleash a nuclear fusion explosion.

The Lotus Heart Parrot released its special move to stop the Red Demon but still failed. The Aotian Shenlong fought against the Hades Dragon King to buy time for Fei Lun and others to escape from the temple. Qingya and Lingbo Xiong work together to help everyone release the suspension bridge. The Red Demon defeated the Aotian Shenlong and threatened everyone to hand over the other half of the arcane core. Dr. Zhuang handed the Magnet a mini-bomb with the intention of blowing up the temple and burying the Red Devil, but the plan failed. Seeing that the speeders were already scarred, the Wild Fire Lion used a fake chip to lure the Red Demon away, and together with the Lightning Eagle created space for his partners to escape. Afterwards, the two brothers Qilin and Pixiu led Fei Lun and others out of the Earth Temple.

After everyone escaped from the temple, they lost their way in the forest filled with white mist. The Eye of Arcana detected that the mist contained a small amount of PM2.5 and other air pollutants. Fortunately, the situation was not serious. Under the guidance of the doctor and the Eye of Arcana, Qingyang Deer released its skills to disperse the fog. However, when everyone was looking for the speed car, they were stopped by the red demon. Zhan Sen, whose mind was controlled, started a battle with the guardians. In the end, the guardians' calls successfully awakened Zhan Sen. Seeing that this plan failed, the Red Devil made another plan and sent the Dark Tyrant Dragon King to snatch the remaining arcana core. Aotian Shenlong arrived and, with Zhan Sen's life-saving help, released his special move and led everyone to escape from the forest. But the Red Demon also felt the power of the arcane core in the skills of the Aotian Shenlong.

The doctor used energy blocks to barely charge some energy into the dinosaur tanks. He also intelligently analyzed the battle data he recorded and calculated the strengths and weaknesses of each speed car, and produced a new set of information cards. The red devil's card records that his weakness is his unprotected eyes. After knowing this, everyone's hearts dropped slightly. But Yaxi was dissatisfied that Qingyang Deer's information card data was weaker than Qingfeng's Hell Flame Tiger. The two met to compete, and the doctor took them to the training hall and conducted a speed curling match, a speed competition, etc., so that everyone could truly feel and understand the power of sharing and sharing. While they were having fun, the Eye of Arcana suddenly detected the energy fluctuations in the arcana core, and everyone discovered that the Red Demon was indeed heading towards the battle city.

Titles.eng: Charge The Red Devil Is Coming

Summaries.eng: At the request of Aotian Shenlong, the doctor activated the invisible mask to hide the battle city. Aotian Shenlong told them that in the war a hundred years ago, he had to borrow half of the arcane core energy in order to defeat the predators. Now that the Red Demon is attacking, it is so powerful that it is impossible to resist with only the little energy supplemented by the Dinosaur Chariot, so it can only temporarily delay time to find a way. That night, Fei Lun accidentally discovered the notebook left by Zhan Sen, and based on its contents, he and his doctor invented an energy converter that relied on garbage recycling to generate energy. The Fei Lun brothers used electronic screens to tell citizens about the current situation of the earth and asked everyone to send discarded garbage into the energy converter to charge the dinosaur chariot. Citizens came to help. At this time, the Red Demon army has arrived at the city gates, coming menacingly.

On the eve of the great battle, citizens evacuated Battle City en masse. The guardians left behind to confront the Crimson Demon discovered that the Dinosaur Battle Vehicles still lacked full energy. Meanwhile, the Crimson Demon approached directly above Battle City. The group decided that Feilun Qingfeng and the Proud Heavenly Dragon would hold off the Crimson Demon on the rooftop, while the others protected the Dinosaur Battle Vehicles until they completed their energy recharge. During their battle, Feilun Qingfeng discovered a control device on the neck of the Nether Tyrant Dragon, but without the Dinosaur Battle Vehicles to unleash its ultimate attack, they were powerless to destroy it. Meanwhile, the crowd in the plaza faced the reinforced giant soldiers, employing every tactic to stall them until the Dinosaur Battle Vehicles were fully charged. Just as everyone gathered with the vehicles to join Feilun and the others, they were struck by the Crimson Demon's devastating blow.

Feilun devised a new plan. The Venom Lizard, Lotus Parrot, and Berserker Armor drove Shadow Giants to the rooftop's end, taking them down. Others suppressed the Netherstorm Dragon King. Sun-Moon Deer shattered its dark device, freeing the Dragon King to join their fight.

The Crimson Demon empowered the Giants. One seized Lingdang's parrot, forcing the Celestial Dragon to surrender Omen Cores. Lightning Eagle and Fiery Lion returned, knocking the giant away. Morale soared, but the Demon remained unbeatable.

Feilun targeted the Demon's cores. The team pinned him down with motorcycles, allowing Tyrannosaurus Redflame to seize them all.

As Crimson Flame prepared to leave with the Aura Core, the Crimson Demon broke free and seized him. Feilun commanded all flying vehicles to rescue him, though they were severely damaged. Unwilling to let others suffer, Red Flame tried swallowing the O-Power Core to merge into the Ultimate Core.

Suddenly, Dodo, Yaya, and Xiaofei arrived. They swallowed the core, and the four dinosaur battle vehicles fused into the Ultimate Core, passing it to the Proud Heavenly Dragon. The twelve flying vehicles channeled their energy to the Qilin and Pixiu brothers. The Divine Dragon merged with them, unleashing the ultimate finishing move.

Peace was restored. Feilun and his companions successfully sealed the O-Power Core completely.

Later, Feilun and Qingfeng returned to the commercial district with several new allies. Feilun pulled out the O-Power Eye for a group photo—then suddenly heard a familiar voice calling his name from behind.

Titles.eng: The Mystery Of The Gray Realm
